component.name: Cascade
component.summary: Download and share files with BitTorrent

description.p: Cascade is a BitTorrent client for GNOME with the features of a power-user client. Click any torrent to roll open its transfer details, files, peers, trackers, pieces and options - no extra windows. The same torrents and settings are available from the command line and from a web interface that looks just like the app.

ul.li: Magnet links from your browser, .torrent files, URLs, drag and drop and a watch folder
Bind to a network interface such as a VPN tunnel, with a kill switch that pauses everything when it drops
Fixed, random, VPN port forwarding (NAT-PMP) or file-based listening ports
A weekly schedule for full speed, slow mode and pauses
Queueing, seeding limits, labels, IP blocklists, proxies and encryption
A one-click web interface and a complete command line
First release: GTK4/libadwaita app with expanding torrent cards and a roll-down filter bar
Web interface that mirrors the app, turned on with one click
Command line with every feature, also usable against a remote web interface
Network interface binding with a kill switch, port modes including VPN NAT-PMP forwarding
Weekly speed schedule, queueing, seeding limits, labels, blocklists, proxies, torrent creation
